_doc: Corpus subsets. A value is either a list of DCS time slots (null = undated), or an object {"slots": [...], "exclude_texts": [...]} that also drops whole DCS texts by name. Each subset is built into data/corpora/<name>/ and results are keyed by subset, so dropping a subset leaves no trace.
